# This callback is invoked only by the custom court position's native
# on_court_position_received hook.  No public caller can supply a success bit.
zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_on_native_position_received_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open = 1
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_subject
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_subject = this
            scope:liege = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
            has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
            is_court_position_employer = {
                court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                who = scope:liege
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_owner value = scope:liege }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_position_type_id value = 3612741 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_position_active value = 1 }
        trigger_event = { id = zg361workforceappointmentfact.9001 days = 1 }
    }
}

zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_on_native_position_ended_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_position_active value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_position_end_reason value = $END_REASON$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active value = 0 }
    }
}

# The custom office is a bounded native appointment carrier, not a permanent
# second job.  Only this private effect may release it, and it records that the
# disappearance was package-owned so a natural invalidation can never be
# mistaken for a successful settlement release.
zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_bounded_position_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_command_dispatched
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_command_owner
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
            is_court_position_employer = {
                court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                who = $EXPECTED_OWNER$
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_settlement_release_requested value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_settlement_release_reason value = $RELEASE_REASON$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_command_dispatched value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_command_owner value = $EXPECTED_OWNER$ }
        revoke_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_command_dispatched
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_command_dispatched = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_command_owner = $EXPECTED_OWNER$
            NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_position_active value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner = $EXPECTED_OWNER$
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_released_by_package value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_release_reason value = $RELEASE_REASON$ }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_position_released_by_package value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27407 }
    }
}

# Begin the one real business action.  The intent tuple opens eligibility but
# is not a receipt and never writes a Workforce external alias.  If vanilla's
# can_appoint preflight fails, it is removed in the same effect.
zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_request_native_appointment_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            this = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            $TICKET_OWNER$ = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
            }
            $TICKET_SUBJECT$ = {
                is_alive = yes
                is_landed = yes
                liege = $TICKET_OWNER$
                primary_title = { holder = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
                has_variable = zg361_we_m266_hc_reservation_active
                var:zg361_we_m266_hc_reservation_active = 1
                has_variable = zg361_we_m266_hc_receipt
                var:zg361_we_m266_hc_receipt = $TICKET_CASE$
                has_variable = zg361_ch_hc_reserved
                var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved >= 1
                has_variable = zg361_we_m266_object_id
                has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_id
                has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_id
                var:zg361_we_m266_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
                var:zg361_we_m266_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                var:zg361_we_m266_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                var:zg361_we_m266_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
                var:zg361_we_m266_object_consumed = 1
                var:zg361_we_m272_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
                var:zg361_we_m272_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                var:zg361_we_m272_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                var:zg361_we_m272_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
                var:zg361_we_m272_object_consumed = 1
                var:zg361_we_m273_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
                var:zg361_we_m273_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                var:zg361_we_m273_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                var:zg361_we_m273_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
                var:zg361_we_m273_object_consumed = 1
                var:zg361_we_m272_offer_candidate = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                var:zg361_we_m273_candidate_fingerprint = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                OR = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open }
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open = 0
                }
                OR = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active }
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 0
                }
                NOT = {
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_dispatched
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_dispatched = 1
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_title value = primary_title }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_title_tier value = primary_title.tier }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_hc_case value = var:zg361_we_m266_hc_receipt }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_hc_reserved value = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_offer_object value = var:zg361_we_m272_object_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_candidate_object value = var:zg361_we_m273_object_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_eligibility_open value = 1 }
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_seen
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_owner
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_subject
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_position_type_id
        $TICKET_OWNER$ = { set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_window_open value = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                $TICKET_OWNER$ = {
                    can_appoint_char_to_court_position = {
                        CHAR = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                        COURT_POS = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                    }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_dispatched value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
            $TICKET_OWNER$ = {
                appoint_court_position = {
                    recipient = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_seen
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_seen = 1
                    has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                    is_court_position_employer = {
                        court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                        who = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    }
                }
                zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_seal_and_publish_effect = {
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 5 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27403 }
                trigger_event = { id = zg361workforceappointmentfact.9001 days = 1 }
            }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_clear_pending_intent_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27402 }
        }
        $TICKET_OWNER$ = { remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_window_open }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_dispatched
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_dispatched = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_attempt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27403 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_state = 4
        }
        zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_seal_and_publish_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
            TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27401 }
    }
}

# After the native receipt is published, the existing Workforce #274 route is
# the sole owner of gold/HC settlement.  Ordinarily the probationary position
# is released after that route ACKs.  A D+1 audit may already have released the
# same verified position to keep the slot bounded; the immutable receipt then
# remains consumable, while an unrelated invalidation never qualifies.
zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_consume_workforce_m274_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_published = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_state = 4
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_native_callback_seen = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_native_holder_postcondition_seen = 1
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 1
                    has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                    is_court_position_employer = {
                        court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                        who = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    }
                }
                AND = {
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 0
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_released_by_package = 1
                    NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_workforce_consumer_ack
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_workforce_consumer_ack = 1
                    }
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = zg361_we_m274_business_object_created
                        var:zg361_we_m274_business_object_created = 1
                        var:zg361_we_m274_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
                        var:zg361_we_m274_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                        var:zg361_we_m274_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                        var:zg361_we_m274_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
                        var:zg361_we_m274_object_state = 4
                        var:zg361_we_m274_object_consumed = 1
                        var:zg361_we_m274_native_appointment_confirmed = 1
                        var:zg361_we_m274_appointed_character = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                        var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_type_id
                        var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_id
                        var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_hash
                        var:zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_consumed = 1
                        var:zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_ready = 0
                    }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_workforce_consumer_ack value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_we_m274_route_a_effect = {
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
                    var:zg361_we_runtime_applied = 1
                    var:zg361_we_m274_native_appointment_confirmed = 1
                    var:zg361_we_m274_appointed_character = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_type_id
                    var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_id
                    var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_hash
                    var:zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_consumed = 1
                    var:zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_ready = 0
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_workforce_consumer_ack value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_workforce_consumer_ack
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_workforce_consumer_ack = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 1
                    has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                    is_court_position_employer = {
                        court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                        who = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    }
                }
                zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_bounded_position_effect = {
                    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    RELEASE_REASON = 1
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 0
                    var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_released_by_package = 1
                    NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_release_joined_by_consumer value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed_operation value = 274 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 6 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 5 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27407 }
            }
        }
        else = {
            remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27406 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27406 }
    }
}

zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_m274_appoint_and_consume_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code
    remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_state = 4
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_result = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_native_appointment_confirmed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_id
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_hash
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 2 }
    }
    else = {
        zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_request_native_appointment_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
            TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 0
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_published = 1
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            }
            zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_consume_workforce_m274_effect = {
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
            }
        }
    }
}

# D+1 is only a reconciliation attempt for callback ordering or save/load.  It
# cannot turn the request intent into success without the native callback and
# live position postcondition.  A later central retry of the public wrapper is
# required to consume #274 if publication finished after the original tick.
zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_audit_pending_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = this
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_published = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = this
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 1
                has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                is_court_position_employer = {
                    court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                    who = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner
                }
            }
            zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_bounded_position_effect = {
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner
                RELEASE_REASON = 2
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 0
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_released_by_package = 1
                NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 5 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27407 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open = 1
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_subject
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_cycle
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_case
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_subject = this
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_seen
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_native_callback_seen = 1
            has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
            is_court_position_employer = {
                court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                who = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
            }
        }
        zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_seal_and_publish_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_cycle
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_case
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
                        var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = this
                    }
                }
                has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open
                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_open = 1
                has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
                has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                is_court_position_employer = {
                    court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                    who = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
                }
            }
            zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_release_bounded_position_effect = {
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_pending_owner
                RELEASE_REASON = 3
            }
            zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_clear_pending_intent_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_status value = 4 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code } }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_red_code value = 27404 }
            }
        }
        if = {

                var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 1
                has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                is_court_position_employer = {
                    court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position
                    who = var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner
                }
